resources.string: Tap to let it read and send your text messages.
%1$s can then show your text messages and send new ones from this phone. You can turn this off again on the page of %1$s in Tandem.
Tandem reads your text messages only to show them on your own computers, and sends a text only when you write one there. Nothing goes through a server.
Android only lets apps from a store read text messages until you allow it. Open app info, tap the three dots at the top right and choose Allow restricted settings. Then come back and tap Try again.
